messages.subject: extract maximum of mapped value
parts:
Dear list,

I can't for the life of me find this anywhere online. I have a one-
dimensional data frame whose distribution I plot and I would like to
add some text to the maximum value of the distribution.

my.data <- data.frame(value=rnorm(100))
ggplot(my.data, aes(x=value, y=..count../sum(..count..)) +
geom_freqpoly()

How can I extract the max of that mapped y-value? I tried:

+ geom_text(aes(y=max(..count../sum(..count..))), label="peak")
+ geom_text(aes(x=value, y=max(..count../sum(..count..))),
label="peak")
+ geom_text(y=max(..y..), label="peak")

but none of the objects I supply as y-values can be found.

A link to an answer is totally fine.

TIA,
Moritz
